items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1959-12-09
items.q: They called him Beansy. His name is Edwin Fouye. Him and Butchie Fernandez were partners.

ctx.x: That was at the Taxi Dance Hall. Was that over on Iberville or?

That was on Iberville Street, yeah. They called him Beansy. His name is Edwin Fouye. Him and Butchie Fernandez were partners. He looked like a white man. He looked like a white fella. He's still around.
Is he the one who has the Astoria Hotel?
